## berth tui

an interactive dashboard for hosts and orgs

### Synopsis

A dashboard in the terminal: every org and host with its state, and a page per org with its
connection sheet, firewall, repos, variable names, backups and log.

It can start, stop and restart an org, allow and deny firewall entries, add, remove and sync repos,
take a backup, and hand the terminal to attach or a shell. Anything that restarts a container says
what stops and runs only after a "y". With --read-only it only reads. Press ? for the keys.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_tui/

```
berth tui [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth tui
  berth --read-only tui
```
